technique_name: Name and explain a difference between Buddhism and Hinduism
description: One of the main differences between Buddhism and Hinduism is their understanding of the concept of karma. Hinduism teaches that karma is an important part of the cosmic cycle of reincarnation, whereas Buddhism teaches that karma is one of the causes of suffering, and through Buddhist practice, suffering can be mitigated and can ultimately be avoided.
